candidates.explanation: When no provider is supplied, the user is saved with provider `google` instead of `email`. AuthService.register calls usersService.create without a provider, so every email-registered user is stored as a google user. At login, validateLogin checks `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` and throws 422 `needLoginViaProvider:google`.

fix.description: Default the provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email instead of google.
